acceptance_notes: 90 measured runs plus 18 excluded warm-up runs; all 108 verified.
Execution binaries remained unchanged throughout the run. Only the BSGS CTest parent timeout was changed during this benchmark.
Later BSGS samples also overlapped independent functional corpora using physical GPUs 5 and 6 as ordinal zero, with all devices visible.

Short-process setup and host variability dominate process throughput; kernel events and checkpoint durations are reported separately. Timed cases finish before the 10-second interval and therefore checkpoint primarily at completion.
Runtime journals, targets, and logs remain outside the checkout in the recorded output directory.

report.scope: single visible GPU; fresh processes, one excluded warm-up round; rotating durability order
report.timing: process includes input/preparation, execution, output and cleanup; job creation, table build and post-run audits are separate
